capsize: Capsized. Ease with {lt} and wait for the boat to right.
byTheLee: By the lee. The wind is on the same side as the boom, and it can gybe itself.
Still by the lee. Steer so the wind comes back onto the windward quarter.
deathRoll: The boat is rolling. Sheet in a little with {rt} and hike with {a}, or it can death-roll.
That roll is building into a death roll. Sheet in with {rt} and hold {a}.
irons: In irons. Push the stick away from the sail and wait.
Keep the stick away from the sail. When the bow falls off, sheet in with {rt}.
stall: Stalled — sheeted too tight. Ease with {lt} until the telltales stream aft.
Still stalled. Ease more with {lt}. The leeward telltale should stream aft.
heel: Heeling. Hold {a} and hike out to windward.
Still heeled. Hold {a} until the boat comes flat.
pinned: Ease with {lt} so the sail can shake. Luffing is the point.
luffReach: The sail is still luffing. Sheet in with {rt} until it goes quiet.
Keep {rt} held until the shaking just stops, then let go.
findWind: Turn toward the wind arrow. The bow should meet the streaks.
The arrow on the water points to where the wind comes from. Steer the bow at it.

debrief.tack: Speed kept {kept}% through the tack. Tack score {quality}. A clean one keeps about 60% and scores over 0.55: sheet eased, helm smooth, sailor across while the sail is light.
debrief.gybeLee: The wind got onto the same side as the boom — by the lee — and the boom can crash across on its own.
debrief.gybeSlam: The boom came across hard. Help it across, duck, and move your weight as it crosses.
debrief.gybeClean: Controlled gybe. You called gybe-oh, ducked, and stayed off by the lee.
debrief.gybeOk: The gybe was under control. Next time, look behind the sail before you call it.
debrief.returnClean: Head-to-wind, sail luffing, and made fast without a hard hit. That is how a dinghy stops.
debrief.returnOk: You came back. Next time, luff earlier so the approach stays under about 1.5 kn.
debrief.windClean: Bow into the wind, sail luffing, and you still had steerage. That arc is the no-go zone, about 45° either side of the wind.
debrief.windOk: You found the no-go zone. It is about 45° either side of the wind. Ease the sheet as you turn in so you are not stuck in irons.
debrief.reachClean: Beam reach, sail quiet, boat flat. The telltales stream aft when the sheet is right.
debrief.reachOk: You crossed the wind. Trim until the shaking just stops, and hike if the rail digs in.
debrief.pointsClean: Close-hauled, a reach, and a run. The wheel should have followed you around.
debrief.pointsOk: You visited the points of sail. Close-hauled is toward the wind, a reach is across it, a run is away.
debrief.stop: Lying-to. The sail is luffing and the boat has stopped. Bear away when you want to sail again.
debrief.irons: Out of irons. The bow fell off, the sail filled, and you have drive again.
debrief.capsize: If you capsize, ease the sheet and stay with the boat. It floats. Do not swim for shore.
debrief.card: Read it once before you need it. The boat will still be here.
